caption: The drawing consists of two depictions of the same wooden chest placed against a plain, off-white background. The upper depiction shows a three-quarter view of the chest, which is rendered fully in a reddish-brown color. The chest has a flat top, a keyhole on the upper section, and a large drawer with two round, dark knobs and a second keyhole below the upper section. The chest features light decorative molding and rests on four bracket-style feet. Visible joinery is present on the vertical edges of the chest. Below this main image, there is a partially rendered version of the same chest showing its left side in a paler, more transparent wash of the reddish-brown color with minimal outlines and incomplete color fill, suggesting it is an unfinished drawing. The lines on this lower depiction are fine and faint, with only hints of shading and a single faint round knob sketched in.
title: Blanket Chest
